environment.biasNotes: Linux/ext4 only, per the 2026-07-26 scope narrowing. Development machine; latency and startup thresholds remain hypotheses until a real-hardware pass (A2).

method: Tauri 2 host on WebKitGTK, UI served at runtime over a custom URI scheme; readiness reported by the page through the sink command. Summed process-tree RSS sampled from /proc. AT-SPI exposure probed via pyatspi when available, UNKNOWN when not. SCOPE: Linux/ext4 only; latency and startup gates are hypotheses until a real-hardware pass.

metrics.omitted_gates: latency, stall, cliff, a11y_exposure: run is too short and probing is disabled
metrics.close_path: NEGATIVE, confirmed on a live Hyprland/Wayland compositor (2026-08-10, 3/3 instrumented runs): hyprctl dispatch closewindow triggers CloseRequested, but confirm_close is never invoked; the 2 s fallback thread closes the window every time. The store round-trip check above cannot discriminate a working close from this failure, because SETTLE_MS exceeds the flush debounce and the debounce autosave alone accounts for the saved text.

verdicts.value: NEGATIVE: hyprctl dispatch closewindow fired Tauri's CloseRequested, but confirm_close was never invoked in any of 3 instrumented runs — the 2 s fallback thread closed the window every time. The page's app://close-requested listener is not completing the round trip on this build.
verdicts.threshold: CloseRequested fires and confirm_close is invoked before the 2 s fallback closes the window
